result:
No revisit dates have passed. The next one is the bake-to-order review on 2 Dec.

I checked the ledger first. The free first box and 50% off the first month were both dropped on 2026-10-06. Only 6 of the 52 free boxes turned into paying subscribers, and they used up Saturday slots. The free box only comes back if paid signups fall below 8 a month for two months in a row. October had 15, so that hasn't happened. None of the ideas below brings those back. They also leave out delivery apps and café seating.

**1. Subscriber referrals.** Each of your 140 subscribers gets a code to share. The friend gets a discount on their first month, and the subscriber gets a free box once the friend has paid for a month. This is the reopen condition you set for the 50% discount: "test it with a referral from an existing subscriber." People who come through a friend who already gets the box should stick around better than strangers who signed up for a deal. To keep it small, cap it at about 20 referrals and see how many are still paying after 4 weeks.

**2. Paid tastings, not free boxes.** Give out sourdough slices at the counter on busy weekdays, or at a local market or school fair within your 3 km. Hand people a card with a QR code to subscribe. A tray of bread costs much less than a €7 box, and it doesn't use any Saturday delivery slots. Use a separate code on the card so you can tell which signups came from tastings.

**3. Building and workplace drops.** Find 2–3 apartment buildings or offices within 3 km and sign up a group at one address. Five or more boxes to one stop uses far less of the cargo bike's Saturday capacity than five separate homes. Ask a building manager, office manager or tenants' group to promote it for you. Their reward could be one free box for them, not a discount for everyone. This also works well with bake-to-order, because a group gives you a predictable batch.

One question first: are you close to the Saturday delivery limit? If so, idea 3 should come first, because it grows signups without needing more slots.

If you pick one of these, I'll add it to the ledger.
prompt: Our signups are flat. Give me 3 ideas to get more people to try us.
